title: Feet that stand on the slope
notes: In the walk and run previews, a foot that is down now stands on the ground under it instead of on an imaginary flat floor, so on a slope it no longer sinks into the rise ahead or hangs over the dip behind.
Going downhill, the hips come down a little so the trailing leg still reaches the ground.
Inside caves, and when you stand on a rock or a ruin, the feet move exactly as before.
Still a preview: launch with WAR_WALK_CYCLE=1 for the walk and WAR_RUN_CYCLE=1 for the run. Ordinary launches are unchanged.
